description: This Java source file defines the WrappingMessageMapper class, which implements the MessageMapper interface. Its primary purpose is to enforce message size limits and manage message mapping logic, including adding correlation IDs if missing. The class acts as a wrapper (decorator) around another MessageMapper instance, delegating calls and adding additional processing such as size limit checks and message modifications.

classes.name: WrappingMessageMapper
classes.description: A final class that wraps a MessageMapper to enforce message size limits and add correlation IDs. Implements the MessageMapper interface, delegates method calls, and adds size limit enforcement and message modifications during mapping.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new WrappingMessageMapper that wraps the given MessageMapper.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the delegate MessageMapper.

methods.name: getContentTypeBlocklist
methods.description: Returns the content type blocklist from the delegate MessageMapper.

methods.name: getDefaultOptions
methods.description: Returns default options JsonObject from the delegate.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns incoming conditions map from the delegate.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns outgoing conditions map from the delegate.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with given MappingConfig and MessageMapperConfiguration, including setting message size limits.

methods.name: map (ExternalMessage)
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage to a list of Adaptable objects, enforcing inbound message size limits.

methods.name: map (Adaptable)
methods.description: Maps an Adaptable object to a list of ExternalMessages, enforcing outbound message size limits and adding correlation IDs if missing.

methods.name: checkMaxMappedMessagesLimit
methods.description: Checks if the number of messages exceeds the configured limit; throws exception if limit is exceeded.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the delegate MessageMapper.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on the delegate.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the WrappingMessageMapper including the delegate.
